style: Say softly and calmly, like a mindfulness teacher. Here, an acting coach who starts with breath.
lines: Tap a monologue to read it. Then tap Choose this one.
Answer the six questions. Tap What the play says to check yourself.
Tap between two words where your character changes tactics.
Tap Start, then say it out loud. Tap Next beat as you go.
Tap Start, then say the monologue aloud. To plan changes, open Prepare and Score.
Pick an audience and a version, then tap Hand to partner.
Listen. Tap a word whenever you feel the actor change.
Choose the want you heard, add one word for how it felt, then tap Save.
Compare your bars with the listener’s triangles. Open Prepare and Score to revise a choice.
There are listener flags near every planned change.
You and your listener chose the same closest want.
